english.title: Employer failing to preserve driver's record book

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: DRIVERS HOURS GOODS VEHICLES KEEPING OF RECORDS REGULATIONS 1987

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being the employer of **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..) as a driver, failed to preserve

(A)_[his]_
(B)_[her]_

driver's record book intact for a period of one year from **(..SPECIFY DATE..), the day on which that book was returned to you pursuant to regulation 8(3) of the Drivers' Hours (Goods Vehicles) (Keeping of Records) Regulations 1987
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 11(1) of the Drivers' Hours (Goods Vehicles) (Keeping of Records) Regulations 1987 and section 98(4) of the Transport Act 1968.
